def transform(grid):
    left = [row[:4] for row in grid]
    right = [row[5:9] for row in grid]
    # Overlay the two patterns only when the right-hand pattern is the
    # 180-degree rotation of the left; otherwise retain the left pattern.
    rotated = [row[::-1] for row in left[::-1]]
    if right == [[2 if cell else 0 for cell in row] for row in rotated]:
        return [[2 if right[r][c] else left[r][c]
                 for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)]
    return left
